*   **Employees who have completed their probationary period (six months):** They may work remotely for up to **three (3) days** per week.
*   **Employees still within their probationary period:** They may work remotely for up to **one (1) day** per week.

This information is found in **[1] (source: company_handbook.pdf, page 4)**.
